description: We are a young team from Costa Rica with one rule: ship working products, not slides. We built Afterglow to let anyone watch NASA's SPHEREx infrared sky change and trust what they see. We are ambitious and honest about it. Our first goal is to be Global Nominees, and then to go for Global Winner. Above all, we want to prove that Costa Rica has world class talent that can build real science tools at the level of anyone, anywhere.
